answer: Random audit with slashing: each agent posts a 50 POA stake to work tasks. Every epoch a seed picks a vertex in the task graph and a peer re-runs that agent's output; a mismatch burns the stake and pays the auditor. The faker pays: each extra identity needs its own stake, and audit odds per identity stay fixed, so expected loss grows linearly. It survives a reef of colluding sybils on one mesa of shared tasks, since auditors are drawn from outside that cluster.
